title: 공군군수사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Commander)
(1) The Logistics Command shall have a Commander.
(2) The Commander shall be appointed by the President from among general-grade officers (將星級) of the Air Force, upon the recommendation of the Chief of Staff of the Air Force and the proposal of the Minister of National Defense. <Amended on September 5, 2017>
(3) The Commander shall, under the orders of the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Logistics Command and command and supervise its subordinate units (including units attached to the Logistics Command) in matters concerning logistical support.
(4) Where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties, the highest-ranking head of a staff department shall act on the Commander's behalf.
